_about: Labelled bank-statement lines for the SaaS vendor-identification baseline.
Each entry is a label as a French bank would print it, plus the truth:
saas   — is this line a business software / cloud subscription?
vendor — the vendor name the engine should report, or null.
note   — why the case is in the set (traps, ambiguity, gaps).
The labels are written, not harvested: no real statement was used. They are
chosen to cover the normal case AND the known hard cases, so the score is a
baseline of what the engine can do today, not a demo. Do not tune the engine
against this file before the funded work starts — record, then improve.
Scored by src/lib/baseline.js; results in docs/grants/innovup/evidence/.
